description.en: Radial fold-and-cut in the idiom of Chinese paper-cut window flowers: a red square folded into a 4-, 6- or 8-fold wedge, cut once through every layer and unfolded into an original design. Chinese paper-cut was inscribed by UNESCO in 2009.
description.es: Doblar y cortar en forma radial, al estilo de las flores de ventana del papel recortado chino: un cuadrado rojo doblado en una cuña de 4, 6 u 8 ejes, cortado una sola vez a través de todas las capas y desdoblado en un diseño original. El papel recortado chino fue inscrito por la UNESCO en 2009.
description.fr: Plier-découper rayonnant, dans l'esprit des fleurs de fenêtre du papier découpé chinois : un carré rouge plié en un coin d'ordre 4, 6 ou 8, découpé une seule fois à travers toutes les couches puis déplié en un motif original. Le papier découpé chinois a été inscrit par l'UNESCO en 2009.
description.pt: Dobra e corte radial, no estilo das flores de janela do papel recortado chinês: um quadrado vermelho dobrado numa cunha de 4, 6 ou 8 eixos, cortado uma só vez através de todas as camadas e desdobrado num desenho original. O papel recortado chinês foi inscrito pela UNESCO em 2009.

lineage.source: Original MADFAM motifs (scallops, petals, crescents, arches, diamonds) generated by this cartridge in a generic radial idiom; the object type is attributed to the Chinese paper-cut tradition (UNESCO Representative List, 2009). No traditional artwork is reproduced

label.es: Arcos: pétalos y ventanas de arco
label.fr: Arcs : pétales et fenêtres en arc
label.pt: Arcos: pétalas e janelas em arco

heritage.community: Chinese paper-cut practitioners, across China's ethnic groups (UNESCO)
sources: UNESCO, «Chinese paper-cut», Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, inscribed 2009 (4.COM 13.09) — https://ich.unesco.org/en/RL/chinese-paper-cut-00219 (paper-cuts used for interior decor including windows; transmitted from mother to daughter; regional variation)

Wikipedia, «Chinese paper cutting» — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_paper_cutting (window paper-cuts called window flowers, chuanghua; symmetric designs made by folding the paper before cutting)
